mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 2024, the 20-day forward returns following periods when FEDFUNDS was below 4.0% were not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% and the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market deterioration, which compresses corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following the condition (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% AND UNRATE > 4.5%) are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 3.8%), a decline in industrial production signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 3.8%, the 5-day forward returns following a decline in INDPRO (relative to the previous month) are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following periods of HOUST above 1400 (thousands of units) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising above 1400 and industrial production (INDPRO) is falling below 100, it indicates a mismatch between strong housing demand and weakening manufacturing, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following the condition (HOUST > 1400 AND INDPRO < 100) are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 95), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 95, the 60-day forward returns following a rise in CPIAUCSL (relative to the previous month) are positive in more than 45% of cases.
